items.name: Cubing Cafetalon Recargado 2020

venue.name: Punto Joven Parque Cafetalon
venue.address: Punto Joven, Parque El Cafetalon, 7a. avenida Norte y 5a calle oriente, Santa Tecla.

items.information:
**Cubing Cafetalón Recargado 2020.**

"Cubing Cafetalón 2020" que fue planeada como la primera competencia del año, y que tuvo que cancelarse por motivos del control de la pandemia de Covid-19.

Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA, "Cubing Cafetalón Recargado 2020"  busca cerrar el año ofreciendo una oportunidad de competir oficialmente. 

**- Se aceptará un máximo de UN acompañante por competidor.**
**- Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la cometencia.**
**- El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.**

 
**Cubing Cafetalón Recargado 2020.**

"Cubing Cafetalon 2020" was planned to be the first competition this year, this had to be canceled due to guidelines to prevent the spread of Covid-19.

With national and WCA´s Bio Security guidelines, "Cubing Cafetalón Recargado" is aiming to close this year with the opportunity to compete officially.

**-Only ONE guest per competitor will be allowed.**
**-Temperature will be taken at the venue entrance.**
**-Protective mask MUST be used at all times at the competition venue.**

items.name: Guangzhou Good Afternoon 2020

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Middle School
venue.address: No. 81 Xingyuan Street, Jiangnanxi Road, Haizhu District

items.information:
The structure of the competition in Guangzhou this year has been modified due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Guangzhou Good Morning 2020](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Guangzhou-Good-Morning-2020)** and **[Guangzhou Good Afternoon 2020](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Guangzhou-Good-Afternoon-2020)**, in two half-days respectively.
